product.name: Blood Pressure Measurement Service
product.description: A service to measure the pressure of circulating blood against blood vessel walls, primarily in large arteries.

product.name: Blood Glucose Measurement Service
product.description: A service to measure the amount of glucose in the blood, which is the main energy source for body cells.

product.name: Weight and Height Measurement Service
product.description: A service providing measurement of weight and height along with some body analysis to help understand individual health needs.

product.name: Home Delivery Service

product.name: Pharmacist Consultation Service
product.description: A service allowing customers to ask pharmacists questions and receive professional advice.
